_comment: Tool roles of the Sanity flow (docs/spec/sanity-flow.md): the standalone Synopsys VC Static install /tools/Synopsys/vc_static (the one that ships with VCS under vcs/.../vcfca needs Qt libraries this site lacks, and there is no synopsys/vc_static module; the VCS module would also override VC_STATIC_HOME and put its own vc_static_shell first). No modules: VC_STATIC_HOME and the license server are set per role. `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json, where they are yours to edit. The Tcl setup script (build/sanity/<role>_setup.tcl) is written by Q3TUI; the violations are read from the report it writes (lib/vcstatic.py); `parse` only says when the tool itself failed.

cdc.description: static clock domain crossing analysis (VC Static: check_cdc, report_violations -app CDC)

rdc.description: static reset domain crossing analysis (VC Static: check_rdc, report_rdc)
